text: {"reason":"Broaden the <5-day expedited branch from high-only to medium-or-higher. The medium/2.8 failure row incurs 195000 and one stockout; alert-planner always arrives in time for 35000. This one threshold edit should reduce v1's 34 supplier switches, lower cost below 2165000, and reduce stockouts below 4.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days) (cond ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 5)) (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review)) ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier)) (else (list 'monitor))))"}
